rounds.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original transparent 2.5D hand-painted cartoon fantasy game attack-VFX sprite, specifically NORTHWEST / screen-upper-left facing overhead axe release. Request native 2048 x 2048 PNG with true alpha.
Input images: image 1 is STRUCTURAL REFERENCE ONLY for brilliant ivory-white leading blade and a few fine parallel warm-gold motion filaments; do not copy hero or scenery. Image 2 is the real warrior pose bank: use ONLY the TOP-LEFT release pose. The warrior's raised axe blade is to the UPPER LEFT of the head, its handle slopes down-right toward the hands. Build a new slash for this raised northwestern axe position, never mirror a north/east effect or rotate a generic C.
Output ONLY detached slash light, absolutely no character, axe, weapon, hand, body, armor, ground, scene, UI, text or watermark.
Shape and direction: a SHORT DIAGONAL wide ivory blade sweep on the UPPER-LEFT/front exterior of the raised axe. Its bright leading edge bows gently toward upper-left. The open concave side faces LOWER RIGHT where the warrior will be. Approximately 100–120 degree sweep, distinctly compact and diagonally foreshortened in high-angle 2.5D perspective, NOT a circle fragment drawn upright. Both endpoints are short and sharp: one tapers on the upper-right side, the other tapers on the lower-left side; neither extends down to a torso or feet. A slight brush-strand trail follows the diagonal tangential path, kept tightly adjacent to the wide white blade. Give this diagonal shape its own asymmetry and taper lengths. Leave a large truly transparent wedge on lower-right, zero strokes returning around the character. There should be visible empty air between the intended axe tip and the detached slash.
Style: crisp luminous ivory-white cutting edge, a subtle cream inner transition, only 2–4 thin parallel warm-gold tapered brush strands along that same short upper-left slash. Bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy, controlled small bloom and sparse tiny leading-edge flecks, readable game silhouette.
Composition: one isolated effect centered with generous transparent padding on a square canvas, no pose collage. True alpha inside and behind the blade; no mist filling the open side.
Avoid: long lower tail, C-shaped loop, full ring, protective dome, shield, archway, halo, complete oval, torso/waist/leg enclosure, diagonal full-body wrap, 180–300 degree crescent, rear connecting light, foggy field, colored backdrop or painted checkerboard. This is an ORIGINAL NORTHWEST-specific effect.
rounds.actual_view_note: Rejected: low hanging left end made approximately 150-degree curve; gold halo overly wide.
